friendly_name: Sidebar, TOC rail and page-frame remediation with Header carrier
purpose_context: A review of the published docsite found the page frame, left sidebar and collapsible table-of-contents rail misaligned at most desktop widths, draft pages visible in navigation, and navigation labels shown as raw directory names. This mission makes the layout full-width by default with correctly anchored rails, makes draft publication an environment setting, derives navigation labels and order from page metadata, and adds a toolkit-owned header carrier so a theme can supply its own header.
purpose_tldr: Fix the broken sidebar and table-of-contents rail on wide screens, keep draft pages off the live site, and let themes replace the site header.
